lines.text: Long ago, in a time when devas, humans, and asuras lived across the three worlds, there lived a powerful asura named Mahishasura.
Mahishasura wanted one thing above all else. Power.
So he went deep into the forest and began a long and difficult tapasya.
Days passed. Then months. Then years.
He did not stop.
His determination pleased Brahma, who appeared before him.
Mahishasura asked for a powerful boon. He wanted to become impossible to defeat.
Brahma granted him a boon that no man or deva could defeat him.
Mahishasura thought he was now invincible. And slowly, his pride grew.
He gathered an army and began attacking the devas.
One by one, the devas were pushed from their kingdoms. Soon, Mahishasura's power had spread across the three worlds. The devas tried to stop him. But they could not.
They needed help. So they came together. Shiva. Vishnu. Brahma. And the other devas.
Each one released their divine energy.
The different lights came together… Brighter… Brighter… Until they became one enormous radiant light.
And from that light appeared a magnificent goddess.
Devi Durga.
She stood upon a lion, calm and fearless. The devas knew that she was the one who could face Mahishasura.
But this battle would not be won in a single day. Nine nights of Shakti were about to begin.
And from Durga's radiant form came the first divine light… It travelled far away… toward the mountains.
Who was waiting there?
The first power of Shakti was about to awaken.
